Simulation truth is served only by /truth, labelled simulation_truth.

JSON export -> import round trip is lossless (origins, units, uncertainties, assumptions, provenance).

CSV export: header comments state the label, origin and units; one row per measurement with origin and included flag.

Hand-constructed rows (not a live response): 2/5/6-parameter solutions, NaN -> None, missing RV -> None, J2016.0 TCB kept.

[archive] Reordering the HDUs leaves every array and the flag definitions unchanged.

[math] astropy's -TAB evaluation and an independent bilinear lookup agree everywhere and reproduce the table nodes exactly.
[archive] The WCS-WAVE wavelength over the whole cutout lies within the SIA em_min..em_max of its detector band.
[archive] Two request paths (full-file byte ranges vs IBE cutout) give the same detector pixel and local wavelength.
[math] Same detector with a 0.5-bandwidth offset is incompatible; equal wavelengths on different detectors are incompatible.
[math] Every returned group is pairwise compatible, groups partition the input, and input order does not matter.
[archive] Native frames hold the delivered arrays bit-for-bit; display frames are labelled; no truth; analyses unavailable.
[registration] Display pixels equal a manual bilinear sample of the native image at the archive-WCS position; outside is NaN + NO_COVERAGE.
[archive] Blinkable groups have >=2 available members that are pairwise compatible at the field centre; the contrast frame is not blinkable.
[archive] Absent cache -> 'missing' with the fetch command; failed download -> 'failed'; changed file -> 'failed'. Nothing substituted.
[api] Observed dataset: native/display pixels with units and uint32 flags; analyses answer 409 not_available; no truth.
[pipeline] The synthetic investigation refuses observed datasets (no detection/registration on archive pixels).
[contracts] SPHEREx live capabilities are 'tested'/'failed' only when the validation report records that live test.
[live] SPHEREx: a live SIA2 query in spherex_dr1 returns the same 239 products as the recorded manifest (DR1 is a frozen release).
[live] SPHEREx: byte-range reads of one full DR1 file reproduce the recorded detector pixel and local wavelength.
[live] SPHEREx: a fresh IBE cutout download passes every format check (full 441-zone EPSF) and matches the recorded science arrays.
Same seed -> identical arrays and Dataset JSON; a different seed changes the pixels.
22 band-visits; missing/failed observations keep their reasons and have no frames; mid = start + 90 s; G2 starts 240 s later.
The Dataset served to the UI carries no simulation-truth values or origins; frames are 'simulated' electrons with sky included.
Variance = read_noise^2 + max(image, 0) from the noisy data; hot pixels flagged identically in every frame.
Simulated catalog: J2016.0 TCB epoch, origin 'simulated', C1 5-parameter, V1 2-parameter, some negative parallaxes.
C1 truth displacement between two epochs equals pm*dt + parallax-factor change (written here independently) within 1 mas.
Real registration accuracy per frame: registered-vs-truth WCS error at grid points is within 4.5 sigma of the
C1 is tracked in all 18 frames; image-measured positions vs truth have pulls with |mean| < 0.5 and std in [0.7, 1.4].
Isolated stationary stars (no truth neighbour within 3"): position pulls vs truth have std in [0.8, 1.25] — uncertainties are calibrated.
Fit of image-derived positions recovers the injected pm and parallax within 3 sigma with an acceptable chi2 (p > 0.001).
Derived indicators: C1 displacement significant, V1 flux variation significant, most stationary stars not flagged.
C1 matches its simulated-catalog counterpart at every epoch once catalog astrometry is propagated from J2016.0.
The 1.1" close pair is never reported as a clean unique match in G2 (PSF 1.4"): the blend stays 'ambiguous'.
The pipeline gives identical measurements when the truth is removed from the bundle.
Difference previews are allowed only for registered, same-band frames; G1 vs G2 is refused with a reason.
TT - UTC = 32.184 s + 37 leap seconds (in force since 2017) for a 2025 epoch.
|TDB - TT| < 2 ms (periodic terms ~1.66 ms) across the synthetic schedule.
J2016.0 TCB -> TDB agrees with IAU 2006 Res. B3 (TDB = TCB - L_B(JD_TCB - T0)86400 s + TDB0) to < 1 ms; convention kept.
J2000.0 is MJD 51544.5 TDB; Julian years are 365.25 d; start + 90 s keeps the scale.
Builtin Earth barycentric distance stays within 0.97-1.03 AU and repeats after one sidereal year.
The circular 1 AU teaching observer stays within its declared bound of the builtin ephemeris (1990-2030).
Barycentric observer gives no parallax; spacecraft ephemerides are refused rather than approximated silently.
Geocentre approximation error = parallax * r / 1 AU (165 mas, 7100 km -> < 10 microarcsec).
